nodes.label: F_0.5 evaluation metric
nodes.rationale: Precision-heavy: false merges of two different businesses are more damaging than missed links; weights precision 2x over recall.

nodes.label: Singleton handling (empty list scores 1.0)
nodes.rationale: Predicting any match for a true singleton scores 0.0, so correctly predicting no match earns full credit.

nodes.label: Conservative thresholding under F0.5
nodes.rationale: Rewards extreme certainty before merging entities; cost of a false merge exceeds cost of leaving singletons.

nodes.label: F0.5 formula and per-entity macro-average
nodes.rationale: F0.5 = 1.25*P*R/(0.25*P+R); beta=0.5 weights precision twice as much as recall, so false merges cost more than missed links; singleton empty list scores 1.0, any match on a singleton scores 0.0.
